name: Dominate — Advanced — Still the Mortal Flesh

system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and win a normal Mental Challenge against the subject to shut off or disrupt one involuntary bodily function, such as hearing, sight, circulation, perspiration, or reflexes. Works on both mortals and vampires, though stopping a vampire's circulation or breathing has no effect; a mortal whose heart is stopped dies instantly unless given prompt medical attention.
